Senator Bailey, Representative Gramlich, and members of the Committee, I
am Stacy Bergendahl, Senior Staff Attorney at the Bureau of Insurance. I am here
today to testify in favor of LD 1195, An Act to Amend the Provisions of the Maine
Workers` Compensation Act of 1992 Governing Requirements for Self-insurers, which is a department bill put forth by the Bureau. This bill puts forth a number of clean-up changes in Title 39-A, the title that deals with workers' compensation, in the section that sets forth the requirements for self-insurers.` These changes are primarily technical clean-ups and aligning state requirements with federal rules, and they include:
